module rtlpp_03577(
  input aclk,
  input aresetn,
  input [31:0] s_axi_awaddr,
  input [2:0] s_axi_awprot,
  input s_axi_awvalid,
  output reg s_axi_awready,
  input [31:0] s_axi_wdata,

  input s_axi_wvalid,
  output reg s_axi_wready,
  output reg [1:0] s_axi_bresp,
  output reg s_axi_bvalid,
  input s_axi_bready,
  input [31:0] s_axi_araddr,
  input [2:0] s_axi_arprot,
  input s_axi_arvalid,
  output reg s_axi_arready,
  output reg [31:0] s_axi_rdata,
  output reg [1:0] s_axi_rresp,
  output reg s_axi_rvalid,
  input s_axi_rready,
  output reg [255:0] m_axi_awaddr,
  output reg [23:0] m_axi_awprot,

  output reg [255:0] m_axi_wdata,

  input [7:0] m_axi_rvalid,
  output reg [7:0] m_axi_rready
);

  always @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
    if (!aresetn) begin
      s_axi_awready <= 0;
      s_axi_wready <= 0;
      s_axi_bresp <= 0;
      s_axi_bvalid <= 0;
      s_axi_arready <= 0;
      s_axi_rdata <= 0;
      s_axi_rresp <= 0;
      s_axi_rvalid <= 0;
      m_axi_awaddr <= 0;
      m_axi_awprot <= 0;
      m_axi_awvalid <= 0;
      m_axi_wdata <= 0;
      m_axi_wstrb <= 0;
      m_axi_wvalid <= 0;
      m_axi_bready <= 0;
      m_axi_araddr <= 0;
      m_axi_arprot <= 0;
      m_axi_arvalid <= 0;
      m_axi_rready <= 0;
    end
    else begin
      // Internal logic which was previously defined in external modules.
      // Assumed behavior for demonstration, as original logic was not provided.
      
      // Example behavior: Pass-through for valid/ready handshake
      s_axi_awready <= s_axi_awvalid & m_axi_awready[0];
      s_axi_wready <= s_axi_wvalid & m_axi_wready[0];
      s_axi_bresp <= m_axi_bresp[1:0];
      s_axi_bvalid <= m_axi_bvalid[0];
      s_axi_arready <= s_axi_arvalid & m_axi_arready[0];
      s_axi_rdata <= m_axi_rdata[31:0];
      s_axi_rresp <= m_axi_rresp[1:0];
      s_axi_rvalid <= m_axi_rvalid[0];

      m_axi_awaddr[31:0] <= s_axi_awaddr;
      m_axi_awprot[2:0] <= s_axi_awprot;
      m_axi_awvalid[0] <= s_axi_awvalid;
      m_axi_wdata[31:0] <= s_axi_wdata;
      m_axi_wstrb[3:0] <= s_axi_wstrb;
      m_axi_wvalid[0] <= s_axi_wvalid;
      m_axi_bready[0] <= s_axi_bready;
      m_axi_araddr[31:0] <= s_axi_araddr;
      m_axi_arprot[2:0] <= s_axi_arprot;
      m_axi_arvalid[0] <= s_axi_arvalid;
      m_axi_rready[0] <= s_axi_rready;
    end
  end

endmodule
